entities.summary: Earl Cyril Palmer was an American drummer. Considered one of the inventors of rock and roll, he is a member of the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Earl Palmer was a composers & musicians from New Orleans (1924-10-25, New Orleans–2008-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
